name: AFRA 3152
title: Race, Ethnicity, and Nationalism
description: (Also offered as ANTH 3152.) Popular and scholarly theories of human group identity and diversity, in cross-cultural and historical perspective. Topics include: an overview of 'race' and 'ethnicity' in Western thought, ethnic group formation and transformation, political mobilizations of group identity, and systems of inequality. CA 2. CA 4.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
